import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Test 1: Series/DataFrame of datetime64 cast to SparseDtype then .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit)
values = pd.DatetimeIndex(["2020-01-01", "2020-01-02"]).as_unit('us')
for unit in ['s', 'ms', 'us', 'ns']:
    try:
        s = pd.Series(values).astype(pd.SparseDtype(values.dtype))
        result = s.to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit)
        probe(f'Series/DataFrame of datetime64 or timedelta64 cast to SparseDtype(values.dtype) then .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit) for unit in [\'s\',\'ms\',\'us\',\'ns\'] (values = DatetimeIndex([...]).as_unit(\'us\')) - {unit}', result)
    except Exception as e:
        probe_exception(f'Series/DataFrame of datetime64 or timedelta64 cast to SparseDtype(values.dtype) then .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit) for unit in [\'s\',\'ms\',\'us\',\'ns\'] (values = DatetimeIndex([...]).as_unit(\'us\')) - {unit}', e)

# Test 2: DatetimeIndex with specific dates as CategoricalIndex → to_json with epoch format
dt_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(["1969-12-31 23:59:59.500000", "1970-01-01 00:00:00.500000"]).as_unit("us")
cat_idx = pd.CategoricalIndex(dt_idx)
for unit in ['s', 'ms', 'us', 'ns']:
    try:
        df = pd.DataFrame([[1, 2]], index=cat_idx)
        result = df.to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit)
        probe(f'DatetimeIndex(["1969-12-31 23:59:59.500000","1970-01-01 00:00:00.500000"]).as_unit("us") as CategoricalIndex index/columns, .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit), unit in [\'s\',\'ms\',\'us\',\'ns\'] - {unit}', result)
    except Exception as e:
        probe_exception(f'DatetimeIndex(["1969-12-31 23:59:59.500000","1970-01-01 00:00:00.500000"]).as_unit("us") as CategoricalIndex index/columns, .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit=unit), unit in [\'s\',\'ms\',\'us\',\'ns\'] - {unit}', e)

# Test 3: DatetimeIndex cast to 'category' or SparseDtype → to_json with epoch format and ns unit
dt_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s")

# Test as category
try:
    s_cat = pd.Series(dt_idx).astype('category')
    result = s_cat.to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns")
    probe('DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s") cast to \'category\' or SparseDtype(values.dtype), .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns") - category', result)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception('DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s") cast to \'category\' or SparseDtype(values.dtype), .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns") - category', e)

# Test as SparseDtype
try:
    s_sparse = pd.Series(dt_idx).astype(pd.SparseDtype(dt_idx.dtype))
    result = s_sparse.to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns")
    probe('DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s") cast to \'category\' or SparseDtype(values.dtype), .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns") - SparseDtype', result)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception('DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s") cast to \'category\' or SparseDtype(values.dtype), .to_json(date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns") - SparseDtype', e)

# Test 4: CategoricalIndex with DatetimeIndex as DataFrame index/columns with different orientations
dt_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s")
cat_idx = pd.CategoricalIndex(dt_idx)
df = pd.DataFrame([[1]], index=cat_idx)

for orient in ['index', 'columns', 'split']:
    try:
        result = df.to_json(orient=orient, date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns")
        probe(f'pd.CategoricalIndex(DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s")) used as index or columns of DataFrame([[1]]) with .to_json(orient=orient, date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns"), orient in [\'index\',\'columns\',\'split\'] - {orient}', result)
    except Exception as e:
        probe_exception(f'pd.CategoricalIndex(DatetimeIndex(["9999-01-01"]).as_unit("s")) used as index or columns of DataFrame([[1]]) with .to_json(orient=orient, date_format="epoch", date_unit="ns"), orient in [\'index\',\'columns\',\'split\'] - {orient}', e)
